description: The nominee's AI scorecard: a 0-100 score on public evidence with sub-scores for site speed, case studies, reviews and social proof, AI assistant mentions and profile completeness, a one-line verdict, a tip and the free link to claim the listing. Signals we could not measure say "not measured". Available once nominees are announced on 5 December 2026.

listing_id.description: Optional listing_id from directory_register, so the boost link opens checkout for that listing.

nominee.description: The nominee: its slug from awards_search (for example "northwind-ai") or its website (for example northwind.ai).

name: awards_scorecard

message.description: One or two sentences to show the user as they are.

title: AI scorecard for a nominee
